Shape.description: Declare a row shape: one typed field per line, with `| None` where the column may be NULL.

Unique key.description: The fields of a unique key, after `name = ` on a line of a shape.

Enum.description: Declare an enum with its labels on one line.

Constant.description: Declare a top-level constant of a single file: a name, its type and one literal of it.

Source.description: Connect a shape to a database table.

Query.description: Declare a query: from, where, select.

Grouped query.description: Declare a query with one row per group.

Join query.description: Declare a query that names another input with let, joins it and writes the match in on.

Query parameter.description: Declare a query with a typed parameter, in an explicit-module project (schema_version = 2).

Join.description: Name another input with let, then join it and write the match in on.

Asof join.description: Name another input with let, then join its latest row at or before each row's time: the keys first, one >= time test last.

Collect query.description: Collect each row's matching rows of a relation let, which ends in order by, into one nested field, in an explicit-module project (schema_version = 2).

Unnest.description: Expand the nested field of the from input into one row per element, in an explicit-module project (schema_version = 2).

Count matching rows.description: Count the rows of each group whose test is True, in a select item of a grouped query.

First value.description: The value at the first row of each group; the order ends in a unique key of the source.

Last value.description: The value at the last row of each group; the order ends in a unique key of the source.

Median.description: The interpolated median of an Int or Float field of each group, a Float that is None for no values.

Quantile.description: The interpolated quantile of an Int or Float field of each group; q is a Float literal from 0.0 to 1.0.

Variance.description: The sample variance of an Int or Float field of each group; pvariance is the population variance.

Distinct combinations.description: The number of distinct combinations of several fields in each group; a row where one of them is None is not counted.

Any row.description: True when the test holds for at least one row of each group, in a select item of a grouped query.

All rows.description: True when the test holds for every row of each group, in a select item of a grouped query.

Def.description: Declare a pure inline function; each call is replaced by its body.

Relationship.description: Name a match between two shapes once and call it in on.

Import.description: Import a declaration of another module of an explicit-module project, with its kind.

Export.description: Export a declaration of this module of an explicit-module project, with its kind.
